title: Descending Stories: Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Released from prison, Yotaro begs the famous rakugo storyteller Yakumo Yurakutei to take him as an apprentice. The story moves back through Yakumo's own youth: his apprenticeship and rivalry-friendship with the free-spirited performer Sukeroku, the geisha Miyokichi, and the tragedy that left Sukeroku's daughter Konatsu in Yakumo's care. A multi-generational drama about keeping a traditional art alive.
life_message: Devotion to an art and to the people who pass it on gives life meaning, even when the past cannot be undone.
